summary: RF Systems Engineer with over 15 years of experience in RF hardware design, manufacturing operations, and data analysis. Skilled in DFM procedures, EVT/DVT/PVT verification, and leading cross‑functional technical projects. Proficient in programming, data mining, and performance prediction for satellite and radar systems.

experience.title: RF Systems Engineer
responsibilities: Lead end‑to‑end design, development, testing, and validation of RF systems for satellite communications.
Develop DFM procedures, checklists, and requirements for antennas, receivers, filters, and amplifiers.
Perform EVT, DVT, and PVT verifications and drive root‑cause analysis using FA processes.
Manage test/production readiness reviews and quality requirements for post‑ramp qualification.
Coordinate with suppliers to provide technical specifications and testing requirements.
Analyze RF performance (NF, Gain, IP3, 1dB‑comp, spurious) and optimize system design.
Monitor manufacturing processes to reduce losses and improve quality.

experience.title: System Data Analyst
responsibilities: Prioritized and extracted big data from Purdue University’s SQL database, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
Developed data collection systems and statistical tools using Excel, SAS, and SPSS.
Created complex charts, temporary databases, and pivot tables for publication.
Designed custom reports and identified additional data collection needs.
Provided documentation and support for non‑routine statistical inquiries.

experience.title: Electrical/Validation Engineer
responsibilities: Defined data requirements for PCBA EVT, DVT, and PVT assembly of touch‑pad devices.
Implemented automated tests for sensitivity, EMI, ESD, and other reliability metrics.
Analyzed IC packaging test yields and field return data to identify root causes.
Developed reliability testing procedures (storage, thermal, drop, tap).
Debugged and troubleshot products in-house and at contract manufacturer sites.

projects.name: 5.8 GHz Laptop‑Based Radar System
projects.description: Designed and evaluated a laptop‑based radar system operating in FMCW and CW modes, capable of Doppler shift, ranging, and SAR measurement in the ISM band with +13 dBm transmit power.
